title: Directional service streams without implicit channels
question: Can one explicit Stream carrier cover unary, server-streaming, client-streaming, and bidirectional service calls without another RPC type family?

current: direct Stream input and output positions

sources.scope: four RPC streaming directions, per-direction order, deadlines, cancellation, and non-rollback
stream parameters/results, unique readable-end ownership, incremental transfer, and backpressure-oriented ABI
RPC transfer of readable/writable byte streams, ownership loss at sender, and flow control

stopCondition: Stop when all four direction topologies share one explicit Stream source form and ownership, failure, backpressure, cancellation, and drain remain observable; do not create an implicit Channel or a stream fn spelling.
